author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing closed top and bottom at the corners and pinched the strands to a point, reading as an hourglass; in the original the strands cross and run on past the rungs.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. Two S-strands crossing at the centre, rungs near each end, strand ends extending beyond the rungs; reads as DNA rather than an hourglass.
omissions: Middle rungs (a third rung would cut the crossing into sub-minimum triangles).
